description.value: Cookies Grill is a long-established, family-run diner in Chilliwack operated by two Red Seal Chefs, known for oversized homestyle breakfasts served all day and scratch-made meals using fresh ingredients. Situated just two minutes off Highway 1 at the Lickman exit in a quieter industrial area, it draws a steady crowd of locals, workers, and travelers. A Platinum-winning breakfast spot with a relaxed, casual atmosphere, it also runs a full-service catering arm across the Fraser Valley.

address.value: Unit A-3 44335 Yale Road, Chilliwack, V2R 4H2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates OSM contact details (phone, address). Takeout is confirmed by Skip the Dishes, DoorDash, and Toast ordering links on the website; vegetarian/vegan/GF options are explicitly stated on the homepage. No mention of bike parking, Wi-Fi, or washrooms appears on the website, so OSM's internet_access=wlan tag cannot be confirmed and those fields remain null.
concerns: OSM tags include internet_access=wlan and internet_access:fee=no, but Wi-Fi is not mentioned anywhere on the website and cannot be confirmed.
Minor address formatting difference: OSM uses 'Unit A-3' while the website uses '#3A'; both refer to the same unit at 44335 Yale Rd.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established, active diner conveniently located near Highway 1 with all-day breakfast, large portions, and dietary-inclusive menu options — a practical and appealing stop for touring cyclists passing through Chilliwack.
